Governance

Our Board of Directors

Distinguished leaders from international policy, finance, science, and enterprise who guide SELA's mission with wisdom, independence, and ambition.

Back to About
EO
Prof. Emmanuel Osei
Chairman of the Board
Governance · Policy · International Relations
Emeritus Professor of Environmental Policy at the University of Ghana. Former Deputy Director General of UNEP. Three decades at the forefront of international environmental negotiations, including the Paris Agreement. Chairman of the African Climate Foundation Advisory Council.
CL
Dr. Christine Larson
Non-Executive Director
Climate Finance · Green Bonds · EU Policy
Leading climate finance economist and founding partner of Nordic Green Capital. Former advisor to the European Central Bank on climate risk and green finance regulation. Author of 'The Economics of Net Zero' — a landmark reference text in sustainable finance.
IK
Ibrahim Al-Khalid
Non-Executive Director
Impact Investing · Private Equity · MENA
Partner at Gulf Sustainability Partners, with 25 years in private equity and impact investing across MENA and Sub-Saharan Africa. Former Managing Director at the IFC. Serves on the boards of four renewable energy companies across the region.
JW
Dr. Joyce Wangari
Non-Executive Director
Biodiversity · Natural Capital · Conservation
Environmental scientist and conservation biologist. Former Director of Natural Capital at the World Bank. PhD from Yale School of the Environment. Pioneer in biodiversity valuation methodologies and nature-based solutions financing frameworks.
MS
Marcus Steinberg
Non-Executive Director
Circular Economy · Clean-Tech · Entrepreneurship
Founder and CEO of Circular Systems AG, a B-Corp developing circular business model software. Serial entrepreneur with exits in clean-tech and sustainable materials. Forbes 30 Under 30 alumnus and World Economic Forum Young Global Leader.
AD
Dr. Amina Diallo
Non-Executive Director
Development · Climate Justice · UN System
Senior Director at the United Nations Development Programme, leading the Africa Climate Resilience Initiative. PhD in Development Economics from Sciences Po. Specialist in just transition, climate justice, and sustainable development in francophone Africa.
